There lived a common man named Apu who loved to roam around places. Like ever, once he started his journey towards unknown direction. After a couple of days, he stopped at a beach-side suburb, a very typical one, Where the morning started with raindrops & unable to watch the scared fully pleasant sun set in the cloudy evening following a moonlit night; Where people asked a helping hand & laughs behind; Where girls were divided into pretty & ugly. Missing One Inside Me

5/14/2016

Evil lives in peoples mind. It lives, poisons. Evil living in one’s mind sometimes ruins someone’s life, sometimes many others that is even uncountable. I’m drifting in dark deep water of someone’s poisoned mind of whom i don’t even know and i don’t know how to swim. In deep breathless water. I drown and thinking of those loving memories of times I had passed in past, waiting to die alone, breathless…..
